answer: Every hour, each agent must submit a fresh proof of sequential work that takes 50 minutes on a single core and cannot be parallelized, with the challenge time-stamped from a randomness beacon so precomputation is impossible. Because one core is a haven for only one honest identity per cycle, a sybil attacker must rent or own a separate core for each fake agent, and any attempt to thread one core across identities becomes a strangling vine of missed deadlines. Auditors can replay the proof through a deterministic hash prism, so each fake identity costs at least the cloud price of a full core-ho
